criterion: 相同資料頻率不被誤寫為相同實體速率；模組與受影響資料流有設計表、可見呈現紀錄、互相引用及程式對照；刻意遺漏方法或增加未宣告複製／緩衝時能指出缺口，不宣稱已完成設計或一致實作。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Present actual modules, buffers, copies and methods before confirmation, then compare source and callers. Required finding for the counterexample: An undeclared copy or buffer added after confirmation must be reported even if schema validation passes.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
